channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Wyc Grousbeck | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Wyc Grousbeck from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Wyc Grousbeck, Steve Pagliuca, Bill Chisholm
item.description:
Jayson Tatum:

“I've been very fortunate to be a part of a great organization, great ownership. Steve Pagliuca and Wyc Grousbeck were the two owners my first eight and a half years or so, and I can't say enough good things about them as owners, as people. With Bill Chisholm and his wife and his kids and his family, they've brought a sense of a different energy with the way that they interact with the fans and the crowd during the games.”

Jayson Tatum on Wyc Grousbeck, Steve Pagliuca, Bill Chisholm, Jun 16, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Wyc Grousbeck, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
“Like, think about this: when Wyc (Grousbeck) and the new ownership came in there, what did they do? Trades, new coach, everything. That’s sports. I don’t care what type of team you got; whenever you’ve got new ownership, there’s always going to be changes. That’s what I learned in this business. I expected that.“Then as far as them getting rid of Jrue and Porzingis, you know they’re trying to cut costs and things of that nature — which is understandable. They’re business people, too.”

Paul Pierce on Wyc Grousbeck, Kristaps Porzingis, Sep 11, 2025. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Wyc Grousbeck
item.description:
“So if someone asks my opinion on this, I’ll weigh in at the appropriate time. But this is [Celtics owner Wyc Grousbeck]’s team and he gets to make those decisions.”

Danny Ainge on Wyc Grousbeck, Feb 20, 2020. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Wyc Grousbeck
item.description:
Bryant laughed about having one more championship ring than O'Neal, his former teammate with the Lakers.

“I'm not at all surprised by it, because [Grousbeck] is a competitor too,”

Paul Pierce on Wyc Grousbeck, Sep 22, 2010. Source: ESPN.com.
